rationale: M1 BTCUSD is spread-negative (move/cost 1.7x). H1 move/cost ~36x makes the OsMA edge survive real ECN cost. Validated tick/M30-path + walk-forward + native vectorbt from_order_func (two independent engines agree).

entry.notes: Entry filters tested (bulls/bears power, ATR/EMA, forming-candle strength) are TIMEFRAME-SPECIFIC and did NOT transfer from M1; on H1 the raw OsMA cross + exit model is the validated edge. Power polarity FLIPS on H1 (extreme power = exhausted move).

exit.basket_trail: single stop trails behind basket peak; all legs close together on hit or OsMA sign-flip

money_management.sizing: floor(balance / GBP_per_001) x 0.01 lot total, split equally (whole 0.01) across up to 4 legs, COMPOUNDING per balance
money_management.parallel_accounts: open a new account when size would exceed 100 lots (~GBP500k at GBP50/0.01)

cost_model_real_ecn.broker: VT Markets / Fusion Markets Raw ECN
cost_model_real_ecn.note: DEMO has NO spread/slippage and hid this - always model real ECN cost.

custom_sim_basket.note: 3-fold WF on M30 and M15, all folds positive OOS

caveats: In-sample compounded returns (+27000%) are meaningless; use OOS fresh-5000 figures.
Slippage modeled flat 100pt/fill; real slippage grows with size and in fast moves.
Swap/overnight financing NOT modeled (H1 baskets can span rollover).
M30-path fills, not tick-exact (adequate since H1 moves >> spread).
Large-size compounding limited by 100-lot/account cap -> parallel accounts (operationally heavy).

vectorbt_artifacts.onnx_integration: trade records + entry features exported for ONNX ML validation
